acceptance: The source of the automatic update-branch on #2769 is identified (workflow, app or setting)
Either that source no longer updates pull request branches, or its commits are attributed so they do not need extra approval
docs/operations/repo-admin-settings.md records the rule and the recovery
description: On #2769 a merge of develop was pushed at 14:02 UTC as commit 1e08adaa1 (committer web-flow, timeline actor "GitHub") right after a close/reopen. All required checks then passed and no thread was open, but the pull request stayed BLOCKED. The develop ruleset sets require_extra_approval_for_unattributed_changes, and the author cannot approve their own pull request. Rebuilding the same tree as an author-made merge commit unblocked it. Nobody knows what performed the update, and the update also invalidated a head-specific stand-in.
